product.title: Sydney Walking Tour including The Rocks

description.text: In Sydney, this walking circuit starts at Hyde Park and St. Mary's Cathedral, then continues past Hyde Park Barracks, Queen's Square, and Macquarie Street before the Royal Botanic Garden Sydney. The later stretch covers The Rocks lanes around Suez Canal, Nurses Walk, Playfair Street, Argyle Street, and Campbells Cove. The published format is on foot rather than a harbour cruise or coach day. The format suits visitors who want a compact historic-core walk without assembling those streets independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Sydney, and the itinerary stays on Hyde Park, The Rocks, and the garden edge that define this outing rather than a Bondi beach circuit.
